title: 7 Days DevOps Challenge
description: For this project, I wanted to learn more about DevOps and AWS, which is why I decided to do the 7-day DevOps Challenge created by NextWork. Over the course of the project, I set up a web app in AWS, set up IAM roles and policies, connected a GitHub repo to it, stored dependencies in CodeArtifact, packaged an App with CodeBuild, deployed an app with CodeDeploy and set up a CI/CD code pipeline to automate the deployment of the app.
learnings: Learned about how to build and deploy a web application on AWS, Learned to use AWS tools, including EC2 instances, S3 storage buckets, CodeBuild, CodeArtifact, CodeDeploy, CodePipeline, IAM Roles and Policies, and SSH connections.
